Adding `inArray` to the Drizzle ORM imports for the member repository queries. The `countActiveMembers` helper will count both active and suspended members as seated. Also adding `ne` to the organization repository imports for filtering out suspended members.

Adding an `occupiesSeat` helper comment. The issue-service import cycle is safe because member-service does not import back into issue-service. Loading the full module is acceptable since the error value must be thrown. Comment service tests will remain unaffected.

Running tests after edits to verify correctness. The final message will be minimal or empty.
